description: This file defines the NamedFormula class, which extends the DefinedName class to represent named formulas within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods to construct a named formula, and to get and set its formula value.

classes.name: NamedFormula
classes.description: A class representing a named formula in a spreadsheet, allowing for creation, retrieval, and modification of formulas associated with a named range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a NamedFormula object, validating that a formula is provided.

methods.name: getFormula
methods.description: Returns the formula string associated with the named formula.

methods.name: setFormula
methods.description: Sets the formula string for the named formula, updating the internal value.
